donors.reason: Etoposide is a DNA synthesis inhibitor and topoisomerase poison, plausible for histone/chromatin perturbation; highest anchor similarity.
Bortezomib reversibly inhibits the 26S proteasome, indirectly affecting histone turnover and chromatin regulation; high anchor similarity.
Carfilzomib is an irreversible proteasome inhibitor, can alter histone dynamics and chromatin state; moderate-high anchor similarity.
Alvocidib/flavopiridol is a CDK9 inhibitor, directly linked to RNA Pol II and chromatin-associated histone modifications.

revised_hypotheses: OSI-027 at 2 uM for 24 h produces a reproducible histone perturbation in A375 cells, strongest on H3K27me0K36me2, H3K27ac1K36me2, and H3K27me1K36me1.
Donors with high anchor similarity and chromatin-relevant pharmacology are more likely to transfer a target-minus-A375 response preserving the OSI-027 histone profile.
Etoposide, Bortezomib, Carfilzomib, and flavopiridol are supported donor candidates; Resveratrol lacks retrieved pharmacology and is excluded.
unresolved: No retrieved source describes OSI-027 itself or its direct histone effects.
Resveratrol had high anchor similarity but no retrieved source, so it cannot be supported.
Target-minus-A375 histone responses for the selected donors are not available, so transferability remains unverified.
